0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7) as the 10th game of their season, with the Heat sitting 10th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast after a loss in their last outing, and they are 2-3 on the road. Sacramento, 15th in the West and 5.5 games back in the Pacific, has also lost its last game and is 0-3 at home, and Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are all out for the Kings. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Heat won their most recent meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20.
